notes.title: Map 1 Ground changes + New Locomotives
notes.content:
First off i must apologise for messing up peoples world 1 saves but it was the first test world and needed some big improvements ( much of the ground has been smoothed out and many many more miles of flat routes built into the map, cuts though mountains and more) 
Textures trees and grass are yet to be finalised but the ground shape is ready and i wanted to get it out asap. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/x9YEslI.png[/img]


Rendering ---
Optomisation for Bridge support rendering
Optomised Rails without sleepers
More changes to many LOD levels 
Changed the way locotive liverys are applied and saved to allow for more variation in the future(some existing ones may change to be missing untill the get added to the new system)

Traction changes (wheel slip traction has been decresed and static traction has been increased) to bring it closer to real life
Physics improvements to BR24 (no longer wants to hop over every corner)
many other small improvements i lost the notes for sorry. 

New stuff ---
New GP38
New SD40-2
New Euopien Tanker (3 liverys)
New ContainerWagon (3 liverys)
New Narrow Gauge Tanker wagon
New Buildable factory 


Networking ---
More work on making sure cargo vehicles sync propperly(its a hard problem)
